title: Autopsy and Confession
author: Ansel Eastwick
blurb: Vesper Oyelaran, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
